description: Light Rail Routes is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Energy Commission. This data is intended to assist staff and visitors to the California Energy Commission headquarters, 715 P Street, 3rd Floor, Sacramento, CA 95814 with nearby parking and transportation information. This information was collected from various sources and updated to the best of our knowledge. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Energy Commission. Its tags are CAOpenData, California Energy Commission, California Natural Resources Agency, Parking, Transportation. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
